description.value: In Er G Plant Alchemy is a Victoria-based raw, plant-based wellness shop specializing in cold-pressed juices, smoothies, health shots, cleanses, nut milks, and raw food. All products are 100% vegan, gluten-free, and made without artificial colours, flavours, or preservatives. The business operates as a pick-up and delivery service, making it a convenient stop for cyclists seeking nutrient-dense, whole-food refreshments in the downtown Victoria area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active plant-based juice and raw food shop in Victoria offering pick-up and delivery, with products described as 100% raw, gluten-free, and vegan — corroborating OSM's diet:vegan=yes tag. The contact page confirms the phone number (778) 677-7689 matches OSM. No street address beyond the postcode is present in OSM or on the website, and no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM email tag is 'info@inerplantalchemy.ca' (missing 'g') but the website contact page lists 'info@inergplantalchemy.ca' — OSM email is likely a typo.
No street address is available in OSM or on the website; only postcode V8W 1R9 is known.
OSM tags this as amenity=restaurant, but the business operates primarily as a pick-up/delivery juice and raw-food shop rather than a dine-in restaurant.
